title: Cognitive Logistics Architectures: The Role of Predictive Analytics and Operational Intelligence in the Construction of Autonomous Supply Networks
content: This scientific article explores the potential of Cognitive Logistics Architectures, highlighting the central role of Predictive Analytics and Operational Intelligence in the formation and management of Autonomous Supply Networks. Based on data collected over the past five years, the research adopts methodologies grounded in Machine Learning (ML) and predictive analytics techniques to validate models applied to route optimization and inventory management. The results indicate significant improvements in operational efficiency, cost reduction, and greater adaptability to the dynamic challenges of the contemporary logistics landscape.
